edits.before: I out-range his entire kit at level 1 — he has one lone turret and no grenade yet, and my cannon Q fired through the Acceleration Gate chunks him before any beam reaches me. Punish him the instant he steps up to last-hit. Once I have E at 2-3, the gated Shock Blast pops a freshly placed turret before its beam ramps to full damage, so he can never anchor a nest on the wave. Don't swap to Hammer yet; this is a pure poke war from max distance, and I win every exchange his short-range beams can't answer.
